decisions.decision: Product archetype. Skill + reconstruction artifact first (M1), package/validator/CLI next (M2), FilePress site on gaplast.dev later (M3).
decisions.rationale: GENESIS §15. The prohibition is the product. M1 already exists in this folder. Do not invent a stack that skips the order.
alternatives_considered: Ship CLI before the skill can run

decisions.decision: Markdown reconstruction is the source of truth. JSON is a projection for tests and a future CLI.
decisions.rationale: GENESIS §7. The reconstruction is the format. Do not wrap another app's disk format.

decisions.decision: House stack: TypeScript, ESM only, pnpm, Node 20+. package.json name gaplast, private until Sam publishes.
decisions.rationale: GENESIS N5 and house defaults. Agents never npm publish. gaplast@0.0.0 is a name hold, not this tree.

decisions.decision: Site engine is FilePress (getfilepress) under site/. Do not hand-roll. Do not scaffold in M1.
decisions.rationale: GENESIS F23 / §17. House pattern matches smellcheck. FilePress is markdown → static build, no admin UI, no database.

decisions.decision: LocalSlip names local ports when a FilePress or CLI preview is running. FilePress already uses ensure-lease.
decisions.rationale: Sam named LocalSlip for this project. localhost is the machine; LocalSlip is the slip. Prevents Vite port shuffle from breaking bookmarks.

decisions.decision: Local-first. No PocketBase, no auth, no runtime LLM API in this repo for v1.
decisions.rationale: GENESIS N1–N2, F20–F22. Reconstructions are produced by the user's agent following the skill. CLI validates; it does not call a model.

decisions.decision: Source gathering: user packet plus named URLs only. No unsolicited browsing for a cause.
decisions.rationale: GENESIS §7.4 / Q1. Too much fetching turns the tool into a generic research assistant.
alternatives_considered: Live web search API in v1

decisions.decision: Confidence is settled / provisional / open. No 0–100 scores in v1.
This tree is MIT. npm name-hold stub stays Apache-2.0 until Sam replaces it.
alternatives_considered: Keep Apache-2.0 for the real package

decisions.decision: GitHub remote is Catalyst-Forge-LLC/gap-last. Keep GENESIS order: M2 now, FilePress/LocalSlip later.
decisions.rationale: Sam provided the repo and said proceed after the A/B/C choice. Did not pick FilePress-first.
alternatives_considered: Pull FilePress and LocalSlip forward now

decisions.decision: Pull M3 FilePress site now. LocalSlip lease gaplast-site on 5200 (5198 is haulout-site). Homepage is the sentence, not the eight steps. Spec and paper are generated pages from docs/.
decisions.rationale: Sam said proceed after M2. GENESIS F23 / M3.

decisions.decision: Do not publish the living spec, paper, or GENESIS as site pages. Deed holds the nine-section order and stop questions. Private corpus tools stay off this repo.
decisions.rationale: Sam: unpublished drafts should not be on gaplast.dev. GENESIS is the builder spec, not a public manual.
alternatives_considered: Publish a thinned public spec page

decisions.decision: Purge out-of-scope draft receipts from this tree. Keep the method contract, paper rationale, GENESIS builder spec, and Langtang facts. Rewrite history before the remote goes public.
decisions.rationale: Sam said purge what we need, then B, then that the repo will be public.

gotchas.note: pnpm exec does not expose the root package bin on Windows unless the package is linked to itself (devDependency gaplast: link:.). Use pnpm gaplast as the documented command.
